correlation_state: terciles of lagged rolling correlation within discovery, then frozen numeric cutpoints
WIN_volatility_state: terciles of lagged realized WIN volatility within discovery, then frozen numeric cutpoints
WDO_volatility_state: terciles of lagged realized WDO volatility within discovery, then frozen numeric cutpoints
joint_volatility_state: deterministic pair of frozen WIN/WDO volatility states
relative_momentum_state: sign of lagged WIN return minus negative WDO return under synchronized return normalization
